name: ModelVariant143Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant143us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a 13x13 Gouraud wave scrolls under the slot while the light dims and recovers, a ring of textured quads spreads from one model joint, 96 sparks fly from another to points around the slot, 48 shaded domes open in turn and spark bursts scatter around the opposing slot); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the wave, quads, sparks and domes, packs the texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns, testing the elapsed time after this frame's step, 0 while it is below spark_start + flight_time + dome_time / 3, 4 while it is below spark_start + flight_time + 48 * interval + dome_time / 3, 2 once it exceeds fade_start + wave_fade (resetting the slot ambient), 1 once in between and 0 otherwise; these return thresholds are separate from dome rendering, which draws dome k for dome_time from spark_start + flight_time + k * interval; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-160 and 290 images build it from the same source without the work-size printf and its string and bind its data names 0x28 lower; the US slot-1 image keeps a wrapper only for the format-string padding bytes. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
